remarks: A fresh, updated rental offering style, space, and everyday comfort in a convenient Norwalk location. This Cape features a bright, modern kitchen with crisp white cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and warm hardwood floors that flow into the dining area, creating an easy, open feel for daily living. The living room offers generous space and natural light, with hardwood floors continuing throughout much of the home. Three well sized bedrooms are located on the main level, providing flexible options for sleeping, working from home, or guests, while an additional finished space downstairs adds versatility. Two full bathrooms, one on each level, have been tastefully updated with clean tile finishes and modern fixtures. The finished lower level offers valuable bonus space ideal for a rec room, office, or storage. Outside, enjoy a private yard perfect for relaxing or entertaining, along with convenient on street parking. Set close to local shops, dining, and commuter routes, this move in ready rental blends comfort, function, and a polished look you will love coming home to.
